name: Zig Zag | 1 1/4 Papers | Organic Hemp
description: Zig-Zag Organic Hemp 1 1/4 Rolling Papers are an extremely thin rolling paper made from unbleached hemp that was harvested from organic farms in an environmentally friendly manner. These papers burn nice and slow and give you less of a paper taste when smoking and are an environmentally friendly option for the smoking connoisseur who doesn't want to hurt the planet in the process!
